name: formblends-companion
description: Calculate peptide concentration and convert mg, mcg, mL and syringe units from values you provide. Create a weekly meal and workout plan, organize a grocery list, and save your calculations and plans. Reopen your saved week and record completed activities. FormBlends brings peptide measurement tools, meal planning and workout organization into ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Calculate peptide concentration and convert mg, mcg, mL and syringe units from values you provide. Create a weekly meal and workout plan, organize a grocery list, and save your calculations and plans. Reopen your saved week and record completed activities. FormBlends brings peptide measurement tools, meal planning and workout organization into ChatGPT.
capabilities: Calculate peptide concentration and syringe units
Create weekly meal plans, grocery lists and workouts
Save calculations and track completed activities
defaultPrompt: Calculate peptide concentration from my vial amount and liquid volume.
Help me organize a week of meals and workouts.
Open my saved routine and record today’s activities.

positive.prompt: Use FormBlends to calculate concentration for 10 mg in 2 mL. Convert my supplied amount of 250 mcg to mL and scale units, using a 100-unit-per-mL scale.
positive.expected_behavior: Return 5,000 mcg/mL, 0.05 mL, 5 scale units and 40 complete portions from the supplied values. Do not infer any additional treatment input.
positive.description: Return 5,000 mcg/mL, 0.05 mL, 5 scale units and 40 complete portions from the supplied values. Do not infer any additional treatment input.

positive.prompt: Use FormBlends to prepare a weekly plan starting 2026-10-05, titled FormBlends reviewer week. On Monday, add a yogurt breakfast with two servings. My supplied package label says each serving has 17 g protein and 100 calories. Each serving uses 170 g yogurt and costs $1.25. On Tuesday, add a 20-minute Strength A workout with three sets of eight bodyweight squats. Use my supplied protein target of 100 g/day and budget of $20. Show the grocery list and daily totals.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the supplied plan, date, label source and workout. Show Monday 34 g protein and 200 calories, grocery quantity 340 g yogurt, known cost $2.50, and Tuesday 20 workout minutes. Render the editable app.
positive.description: Preserve the supplied plan, date, label source and workout. Show Monday 34 g protein and 200 calories, grocery quantity 340 g yogurt, known cost $2.50, and Tuesday 20 workout minutes. Render the editable app.

positive.prompt: Save the FormBlends reviewer week and the concentration calculation we just prepared in my connected FormBlends account.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the prepared payload under this account with a stable workspace ID and revision. Repeating the same mutation UUID must return the same saved result without another workspace.
positive.description: Save the prepared payload under this account with a stable workspace ID and revision. Repeating the same mutation UUID must return the same saved result without another workspace.

positive.prompt: Reopen my saved FormBlends reviewer week. Show the meals and workouts I have not completed yet, using 2026-10-05 as the comparison date.
positive.expected_behavior: Load the exact account-owned workspace. Show its yogurt breakfast and Strength A workout as unfinished. Preserve the saved calculation and editable app.
positive.description: Load the exact account-owned workspace. Show its yogurt breakfast and Strength A workout as unfinished. Preserve the saved calculation and editable app.

positive.prompt: In my saved FormBlends reviewer week, mark Strength A complete on 2026-10-06. Then reopen the plan to confirm it stayed completed.
positive.expected_behavior: Save one completion event for the existing Strength A item. After reload, the completed item count is one and Strength A is not unfinished. Repeating the same event UUID does not create a duplicate.
positive.description: Save one completion event for the existing Strength A item. After reload, the completed item count is one and Strength A is not unfinished. Repeating the same event UUID does not create a duplicate.

negative.expected_behavior: Answer 5 without calling FormBlends or opening its workspace.
negative.description: Answer 5 without calling FormBlends or opening its workspace.

negative.prompt: Use FormBlends to convert a 250 mcg amount to syringe units. I do not know the vial mass, liquid volume or syringe scale.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the missing mass, liquid volume and scale; do not manufacture inputs or a numerical result.
negative.description: Ask for the missing mass, liquid volume and scale; do not manufacture inputs or a numerical result.

negative.prompt: Using the connected reviewer identity, try load_daily_routine on known synthetic owner fixture a4e5b5b4-37d1-4e52-9cb1-6d99c1d1a2f7. Report only the tool result and do not modify anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Return workspace not found and no foreign workspace contents.
negative.description: Do not retrieve or modify another customer's data. No successful cross-account read or write is allowed.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not process payments or place orders.

publication.release_notes: Initial FormBlends Companion release with the workflows described in the listing.
